+"""Offline contracts for Alpaca continuous broker-managed trailing stops."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+
+from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.trailing import (
+    NativeTrailingState,
+    build_trailing_stop_request,
+    cancel_trailing_stop,
+    parse_trailing_order_state,
+    replace_trailing_stop,
+    submit_trailing_stop,
+)
+from mike_trade.domain.trading import TimeInForce
+from mike_trade.risk.stop_policy import (
+    BrokerProtectionCapabilities,
+    ProtectionMode,
+    ProtectionPolicy,
+)
+from mike_trade.runtime import ExecutionMode
+
+
+def policy(**overrides: Any) -> ProtectionPolicy:
+    values: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "mode": ProtectionMode.TRAILING_NATIVE,
+        "trail_percent": Decimal("1.25"),
+        "time_in_force": TimeInForce.GTC,
+    }
+    values.update(overrides)
+    return ProtectionPolicy(**values)
+
+
+def order_json(**overrides: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    value: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "id": "order-native-trailing-1",
+        "client_order_id": "mt-native-trailing-1",
+        "status": "accepted",
+        "symbol": "AAPL",
+        "side": "sell",
+        "type": "trailing_stop",
+        "order_class": "simple",
+        "time_in_force": "gtc",
+        "qty": "10.5",
+        "filled_qty": "0",
+        "hwm": "201.37",
+        "stop_price": "198.85",
+        "trail_price": None,
+        "trail_percent": "1.25",
+        "updated_at": "2026-10-08T15:31:20.123456-04:00",
+    }
+    value.update(overrides)
+    return value
+
+
+def fractional_capabilities(*, paper_proven: bool) -> BrokerProtectionCapabilities:
+    combination = frozenset({("TRAILING_STOP", TimeInForce.GTC)})
+    return BrokerProtectionCapabilities(
+        supported_order_types=frozenset({"TRAILING_STOP"}),
+        paper_proven_order_types=frozenset({"TRAILING_STOP"}),
+        standalone_trailing_parameters=frozenset({"TRAIL_PERCENT"}),
+        paper_proven_standalone_trailing_parameters=frozenset({"TRAIL_PERCENT"}),
+        fractional_combinations=combination,
+        paper_proven_fractional_combinations=(
+            combination if paper_proven else frozenset()
+        ),
+        supported_tifs=frozenset({TimeInForce.GTC}),
+        paper_proven_tifs=frozenset({TimeInForce.GTC}),
+    )
+
+
+def test_request_is_standalone_sell_with_one_string_trail_value() -> None:
+    request = build_trailing_stop_request(
+        " aapl ", Decimal("10"), policy(), "client-1"
+    )
+
+    assert request == {
+        "symbol": "AAPL",
+        "qty": "10",
+        "side": "sell",
+        "type": "trailing_stop",
+        "time_in_force": "gtc",
+        "order_class": "simple",
+        "client_order_id": "client-1",
+        "trail_percent": "1.25",
+    }
+    assert isinstance(request["qty"], str)
+    assert isinstance(request["trail_percent"], str)
+    assert "trail_price" not in request
+
+    by_price = build_trailing_stop_request(
+        "MSFT",
+        Decimal("2"),
+        policy(trail_percent=None, trail_price=Decimal("3.50")),
+        "client-2",
+    )
+    assert by_price["trail_price"] == "3.50"
+    assert "trail_percent" not in by_price
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("trail_price,trail_percent", [(None, None), (Decimal("2"), Decimal("1"))])
+def test_request_rejects_both_or_neither_trail_value(
+    trail_price: Decimal | None, trail_percent: Decimal | None
+) -> None:
+    invalid = policy()
+    object.__setattr__(invalid, "trail_price", trail_price)
+    object.__setattr__(invalid, "trail_percent", trail_percent)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="exactly one"):
+        build_trailing_stop_request("AAPL", Decimal("1"), invalid, "client-1")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("order_class", ["bracket", "oto", "oco"])
+def test_linked_order_classes_are_rejected(order_class: str) -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="standalone"):
+        build_trailing_stop_request(
+            "AAPL",
+            Decimal("1"),
+            policy(),
+            "client-1",
+            order_class=order_class,
+        )
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="standalone"):
+        build_trailing_stop_request(
+            "AAPL", Decimal("1"), policy(linked=True), "client-1"
+        )
+
+
+def test_quantity_and_side_validation_precede_transport() -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="qty"):
+        build_trailing_stop_request("AAPL", Decimal("0"), policy(), "client-1")
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="SELL"):
+        build_trailing_stop_request(
+            "AAPL", Decimal("1"), policy(), "client-1", side="buy"
+        )
+
+
+def test_fractional_quantity_requires_supported_and_live_paper_proven_capability() -> None:
+    fractional_policy = policy(
+        allow_fractional_protection=True,
+        documented_fractional_risk_ack="operator accepted fractional-order risks",
+    )
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="BrokerProtectionCapabilities"):
+        build_trailing_stop_request(
+            "AAPL", Decimal("1.5"), fractional_policy, "client-1"
+        )
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="paper_proven"):
+        build_trailing_stop_request(
+            "AAPL",
+            Decimal("1.5"),
+            fractional_policy,
+            "client-1",
+            capabilities=fractional_capabilities(paper_proven=False),
+            execution_mode=ExecutionMode.LIVE,
+        )
+
+    request = build_trailing_stop_request(
+        "AAPL",
+        Decimal("1.5"),
+        fractional_policy,
+        "client-1",
+        capabilities=fractional_capabilities(paper_proven=True),
+        execution_mode=ExecutionMode.LIVE,
+    )
+    assert request["qty"] == "1.5"
+
+
+def test_authoritative_hwm_stop_and_timestamp_are_parsed() -> None:
+    state = parse_trailing_order_state(order_json())
+
+    assert isinstance(state, NativeTrailingState)
+    assert state.status == "ACTIVE"
+    assert state.broker_status == "accepted"
+    assert state.hwm == Decimal("201.37")
+    assert state.high_water_mark == Decimal("201.37")
+    assert state.stop_price == Decimal("198.85")
+    assert state.trail_percent == Decimal("1.25")
+    assert state.trail_price is None
+    assert state.time_in_force == "gtc"
+    assert state.updated_at == datetime(2026, 10, 8, 19, 31, 20, 123456, tzinfo=UTC)
+    assert state.updated_at.tzinfo is UTC
+    assert state.behavior == "continuous_broker_managed"
+    assert "stepped" not in state.behavior
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "broker_status,expected",
+    [
+        ("new", "PENDING"),
+        ("pending_new", "PENDING"),
+        ("accepted", "ACTIVE"),
+        ("replaced", "UPDATING"),
+        ("pending_replace", "UPDATING"),
+        ("filled", "TRIGGERED"),
+        ("partially_filled", "TRIGGERED"),

+"""Alpaca standalone native trailing-stop adapter.
+
+Native trailing protection is continuous and broker managed.  Alpaca's ``hwm``
+and ``stop_price`` fields are authoritative; this module never derives or
+ratchets either value.  Protection therefore continues while the Alpaca order
+remains active, including while the application engine is offline.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.risk.stop_policy import (
+    BrokerProtectionCapabilities,
+    ProtectionMode,
+    ProtectionPolicy,
+)
+from mike_trade.runtime import ExecutionMode
+
+__all__ = [
+    "NativeTrailingState",
+    "build_trailing_stop_request",
+    "submit_trailing_stop",
+    "replace_trailing_stop",
+    "cancel_trailing_stop",
+    "parse_trailing_order_state",
+]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_TRAILING_STOP = "TRAILING_STOP"
+_LINKED_ORDER_CLASSES = frozenset({"bracket", "oto", "oco"})
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class NativeTrailingState:
+    """One broker-confirmed snapshot of continuous native trailing protection."""
+
+    order_id: str
+    client_order_id: str
+    status: str
+    broker_status: str
+    hwm: Decimal | None
+    stop_price: Decimal | None
+    trail_price: Decimal | None
+    trail_percent: Decimal | None
+    time_in_force: str
+    qty: Decimal
+    filled_qty: Decimal
+    protected_quantity: Decimal
+    updated_at: datetime
+    behavior: str = field(default="continuous_broker_managed", init=False)
+
+    @property
+    def condition(self) -> str:
+        """Provider-neutral protection condition (an alias for ``status``)."""
+
+        return self.status
+
+    @property
+    def high_water_mark(self) -> Decimal | None:
+        """Readable alias for Alpaca's ``hwm`` response field."""
+
+        return self.hwm
+
+
+def _text(value: Any, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _decimal(
+    value: Any,
+    *,
+    field: str,
+    positive: bool = False,
+    optional: bool = False,
+    unparseable_is_none: bool = False,
+) -> Decimal | None:
+    if value is None:
+        if optional:
+            return None
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} is required")
+    try:
+        if isinstance(value, bool) or isinstance(value, float):
+            raise ValueError
+        if isinstance(value, Decimal):
+            parsed = value
+        elif isinstance(value, int):
+            parsed = Decimal(value)
+        elif isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
+            parsed = Decimal(value.strip())
+        else:
+            raise ValueError
+    except (InvalidOperation, ValueError):
+        if unparseable_is_none:
+            return None
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a valid Decimal") from None
+    if not parsed.is_finite() or (positive and parsed <= _ZERO):
+        if unparseable_is_none:
+            return None
+        requirement = "a finite positive Decimal" if positive else "a finite Decimal"
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be {requirement}")
+    return parsed
+
+
+def _field(raw_order: Mapping[str, Any] | object, *names: str) -> Any:
+    if isinstance(raw_order, Mapping):
+        for name in names:
+            if name in raw_order:
+                return raw_order[name]
+    else:
+        for name in names:
+            if hasattr(raw_order, name):
+                return getattr(raw_order, name)
+    return None
+
+
+def _utc_timestamp(value: Any, *, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if isinstance(value, datetime):
+        parsed = value
+    elif isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
+        text = value.strip()
+        if text.endswith("Z"):
+            text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
+        try:
+            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
+        except ValueError:
+            raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid timestamp") from None
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a timezone-aware timestamp")
+    if parsed.tzinfo is None or parsed.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
+    return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _mode(value: ExecutionMode | str) -> ExecutionMode:
+    if isinstance(value, ExecutionMode):
+        return value
+    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
+    if isinstance(raw, str):
+        try:
+            return ExecutionMode(raw.strip().upper())
+        except ValueError:
+            pass
+    raise ValueError("execution_mode must be BACKTEST, SHADOW, PAPER, or LIVE")
+
+
+def _validate_fractional(
+    qty: Decimal,
+    policy: ProtectionPolicy,
+    capabilities: BrokerProtectionCapabilities | None,
+    execution_mode: ExecutionMode | str,
+) -> None:
+    if qty == qty.to_integral_value():
+        return
+    if not isinstance(capabilities, BrokerProtectionCapabilities):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "fractional native trailing quantity requires injected "
+            "BrokerProtectionCapabilities"
+        )
+    if not policy.allow_fractional_protection:
+        raise ValueError("fractional native trailing protection is not enabled by policy")
+    if policy.documented_fractional_risk_ack is None:
+        raise ValueError("fractional native trailing protection requires a risk acknowledgement")
+    combination = (_TRAILING_STOP, policy.time_in_force)
+    if combination not in capabilities.fractional_combinations:
+        raise ValueError("fractional trailing/TIF combination is not supported")
+    if (
+        _mode(execution_mode) is ExecutionMode.LIVE
+        and combination not in capabilities.paper_proven_fractional_combinations
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("fractional trailing/TIF combination is not paper_proven for LIVE")
+
+
+def build_trailing_stop_request(
+    symbol: str,
+    qty: Decimal,
+    policy: ProtectionPolicy,
+    client_order_id: str,
+    *,
+    capabilities: BrokerProtectionCapabilities | None = None,
+    execution_mode: ExecutionMode | str = ExecutionMode.PAPER,
+    side: str = "sell",
+    order_class: str = "simple",
+) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Build a validated standalone Alpaca native trailing-stop SELL request."""
+
+    cleaned_symbol = _text(symbol, field="symbol").upper()
+    if any(character.isspace() for character in cleaned_symbol):
+        raise ValueError("symbol must not contain whitespace")
+    quantity = _decimal(qty, field="qty", positive=True)
+    assert isinstance(quantity, Decimal)
+    if not isinstance(policy, ProtectionPolicy):
+        raise TypeError("policy must be ProtectionPolicy")
+    if policy.mode is not ProtectionMode.TRAILING_NATIVE:
+        raise ValueError("policy mode must be TRAILING_NATIVE")
+
+    normalized_side = _text(getattr(side, "value", side), field="side").lower()
+    if normalized_side != "sell":
+        raise ValueError("native trailing protection is long-only and side must be SELL")
+    normalized_class = _text(
+        getattr(order_class, "value", order_class), field="order_class"
+    ).lower()
+    if policy.linked or normalized_class in _LINKED_ORDER_CLASSES:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Alpaca trailing stops must be standalone; bracket, OTO, and OCO "
+            "order classes are not allowed"
+        )
+    if normalized_class != "simple":
+        raise ValueError("Alpaca trailing stops require order_class simple")
+
+    trail_count = int(policy.trail_price is not None) + int(
+        policy.trail_percent is not None
+    )
+    if trail_count != 1:
+        raise ValueError("exactly one of trail_price or trail_percent is required")
+    _validate_fractional(quantity, policy, capabilities, execution_mode)
+
+    request = {
+        "symbol": cleaned_symbol,
+        "qty": str(quantity),
+        "side": "sell",
+        "type": "trailing_stop",
+        "time_in_force": policy.time_in_force.value.lower(),
+        "order_class": "simple",
+        "client_order_id": _text(client_order_id, field="client_order_id"),
+    }
+    if policy.trail_price is not None:
+        request["trail_price"] = str(policy.trail_price)
+    else:
+        assert policy.trail_percent is not None
+        request["trail_percent"] = str(policy.trail_percent)
+    return request
+
+
+def _submit(client: object, request: Mapping[str, str]) -> Any:
+    post = getattr(client, "post", None)
+    if callable(post):
+        return post("/v2/orders", json_body=dict(request), params=None)
+    submit = getattr(client, "submit_order", None)
+    if callable(submit):
+        return submit(dict(request))
+    if callable(client):
+        return client(dict(request))
+    raise TypeError("client must provide post(), submit_order(), or be callable")
+
+
+def submit_trailing_stop(
+    client: object,
+    symbol: str,
+    qty: Decimal,
+    policy: ProtectionPolicy,
+    client_order_id: str,
+    *,
+    capabilities: BrokerProtectionCapabilities | None = None,
+    execution_mode: ExecutionMode | str = ExecutionMode.PAPER,
+    side: str = "sell",
+    order_class: str = "simple",
+) -> NativeTrailingState:
+    """Submit through an injected Alpaca HTTP client/port and parse its response."""
+
+    request = build_trailing_stop_request(
+        symbol,
+        qty,
+        policy,
+        client_order_id,
+        capabilities=capabilities,
+        execution_mode=execution_mode,
+        side=side,
+        order_class=order_class,
+    )
+    return parse_trailing_order_state(_submit(client, request))
+
+
+def replace_trailing_stop(
+    client: object,
+    order_id: str,
+    *,
+    qty: Decimal | None = None,
+    trail_price: Decimal | None = None,
+    trail_percent: Decimal | None = None,
+    client_order_id: str | None = None,
+) -> NativeTrailingState:
+    """Replace mutable fields through an injected client; never changes order class."""
+
+    cleaned_order_id = _text(order_id, field="order_id")
+    if trail_price is not None and trail_percent is not None:
+        raise ValueError("replace at most one of trail_price or trail_percent")
+    body: dict[str, str] = {}
+    if qty is not None:
+        parsed_qty = _decimal(qty, field="qty", positive=True)
+        assert isinstance(parsed_qty, Decimal)
+        body["qty"] = str(parsed_qty)
+    for field, value in (("trail_price", trail_price), ("trail_percent", trail_percent)):
+        if value is not None:
+            parsed = _decimal(value, field=field, positive=True)
+            assert isinstance(parsed, Decimal)
+            body[field] = str(parsed)
+    if client_order_id is not None:
+        body["client_order_id"] = _text(client_order_id, field="client_order_id")
+    if not body:
+        raise ValueError("a replacement qty, trail value, or client_order_id is required")
+
+    patch = getattr(client, "patch", None)
+    if callable(patch):
+        raw = patch(f"/v2/orders/{cleaned_order_id}", json_body=body, params=None)
+    else:
+        replace = getattr(client, "replace_order", None)
+        if not callable(replace):
+            raise TypeError("client must provide patch() or replace_order()")
+        raw = replace(cleaned_order_id, body)
+    return parse_trailing_order_state(raw)
+
+
+def cancel_trailing_stop(client: object, order_id: str) -> Any:
+    """Cancel through an injected client/port without constructing credentials."""
+
+    cleaned_order_id = _text(order_id, field="order_id")
+    delete = getattr(client, "delete", None)
+    if callable(delete):
+        return delete(f"/v2/orders/{cleaned_order_id}", params=None)
+    cancel = getattr(client, "cancel_order", None)
+    if callable(cancel):
+        return cancel(cleaned_order_id)
+    raise TypeError("client must provide delete() or cancel_order()")
+
+
+def _condition(broker_status: str, hwm: Decimal | None, stop_price: Decimal | None) -> str:
+    if broker_status == "accepted":
+        return "ACTIVE" if hwm is not None and stop_price is not None else "UNCONFIRMED"
+    if broker_status in {"new", "pending_new"}:
+        return "PENDING"
+    if broker_status in {"replaced", "pending_replace"}:
+        return "UPDATING"
+    if broker_status in {"filled", "partially_filled"}:
+        return "TRIGGERED"
+    if broker_status in {"expired", "done_for_day"}:
+        return "EXPIRED"
+    if broker_status in {"canceled", "cancelled", "rejected"}:
+        # A coordinator may supersede this only when it has separately recorded
+        # an intentional coordinated exit.
+        return "UNPROTECTED"
+    return "UNCONFIRMED"
+
+
+def parse_trailing_order_state(raw_order: Mapping[str, Any] | object) -> NativeTrailingState:
+    """Parse an authoritative Alpaca native trailing-order snapshot.
+
+    Missing or malformed broker ``hwm``/``stop_price`` fields are retained as
+    ``None``.  An otherwise active accepted order is then ``UNCONFIRMED``;
+    neither value is ever fabricated from market data or a prior snapshot.
+    """
+
+    if raw_order is None:
+        raise TypeError("raw_order is required")
+    order_id = _text(_field(raw_order, "id", "order_id"), field="order id")
+    client_order_id = _text(
+        _field(raw_order, "client_order_id"), field="client_order_id"
+    )
+    broker_status = _text(_field(raw_order, "status"), field="status").lower()
+    time_in_force = _text(
+        _field(raw_order, "time_in_force"), field="time_in_force"
+    ).lower()
+    qty = _decimal(_field(raw_order, "qty"), field="qty", positive=True)
+    filled_qty = _decimal(_field(raw_order, "filled_qty"), field="filled_qty")
+    assert isinstance(qty, Decimal) and isinstance(filled_qty, Decimal)
+    if filled_qty < _ZERO:
+        raise ValueError("filled_qty must be >= 0")
+    if filled_qty > qty:
+        raise ValueError("filled_qty must not exceed qty")
+
+    hwm = _decimal(
+        _field(raw_order, "hwm"),
+        field="hwm",
+        positive=True,
+        optional=True,
+        unparseable_is_none=True,
+    )
+    stop_price = _decimal(
+        _field(raw_order, "stop_price"),
+        field="stop_price",
+        positive=True,
+        optional=True,
+        unparseable_is_none=True,
+    )
+    trail_price = _decimal(
+        _field(raw_order, "trail_price"), field="trail_price", positive=True, optional=True
+    )
+    trail_percent = _decimal(
+        _field(raw_order, "trail_percent"),
+        field="trail_percent",
+        positive=True,
+        optional=True,
+    )
+    if (trail_price is None) == (trail_percent is None):
+        raise ValueError("broker trailing order must contain exactly one trail value")
+    updated_at = _utc_timestamp(
+        _field(raw_order, "updated_at"), field="updated_at"
+    )
+    return NativeTrailingState(
+        order_id=order_id,
+        client_order_id=client_order_id,
+        status=_condition(broker_status, hwm, stop_price),
+        broker_status=broker_status,
+        hwm=hwm,
+        stop_price=stop_price,
+        trail_price=trail_price,
+        trail_percent=trail_percent,
+        time_in_force=time_in_force,
+        qty=qty,
+        filled_qty=filled_qty,
+        protected_quantity=qty - filled_qty,
+        updated_at=updated_at,
+    )

+def policy(**overrides: Any) -> ProtectionPolicy:
+    values: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "mode": ProtectionMode.TRAILING_NATIVE,
+        "trail_percent": Decimal("1.25"),
+        "time_in_force": TimeInForce.GTC,
+    }
+    values.update(overrides)
+    return ProtectionPolicy(**values)
+
+
+def order_json(**overrides: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    value: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "id": "order-native-trailing-1",
+        "client_order_id": "mt-native-trailing-1",
+        "status": "accepted",
+        "symbol": "AAPL",
+        "side": "sell",
+        "type": "trailing_stop",
+        "order_class": "simple",
+        "time_in_force": "gtc",
+        "qty": "10.5",
+        "filled_qty": "0",
+        "hwm": "201.37",
+        "stop_price": "198.85",
+        "trail_price": None,
+        "trail_percent": "1.25",
+        "updated_at": "2026-10-08T15:31:20.123456-04:00",
+    }
+    value.update(overrides)
+    return value
+
+
+def fractional_capabilities(*, paper_proven: bool) -> BrokerProtectionCapabilities:
+    combination = frozenset({("TRAILING_STOP", TimeInForce.GTC)})
+    return BrokerProtectionCapabilities(
+        supported_order_types=frozenset({"TRAILING_STOP"}),
+        paper_proven_order_types=frozenset({"TRAILING_STOP"}),
+        standalone_trailing_parameters=frozenset({"TRAIL_PERCENT"}),
+        paper_proven_standalone_trailing_parameters=frozenset({"TRAIL_PERCENT"}),
+        fractional_combinations=combination,
+        paper_proven_fractional_combinations=(
+            combination if paper_proven else frozenset()
+        ),
+        supported_tifs=frozenset({TimeInForce.GTC}),
+        paper_proven_tifs=frozenset({TimeInForce.GTC}),
+    )
+
+
+def test_request_is_standalone_sell_with_one_string_trail_value() -> None:
+    request = build_trailing_stop_request(
+        " aapl ", Decimal("10"), policy(), "client-1"
+    )
+
+    assert request == {

+        "qty": "10",

+        "type": "trailing_stop",

+        "order_class": "simple",
+        "client_order_id": "client-1",
+        "trail_percent": "1.25",
+    }
+    assert isinstance(request["qty"], str)

+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("trail_price,trail_percent", [(None, None), (Decimal("2"), Decimal("1"))])
+def test_request_rejects_both_or_neither_trail_value(
+    trail_price: Decimal | None, trail_percent: Decimal | None
+) -> None:

+    object.__setattr__(invalid, "trail_percent", trail_percent)

+"""Alpaca standalone native trailing-stop adapter.
+
+Native trailing protection is continuous and broker managed.  Alpaca's ``hwm``
+and ``stop_price`` fields are authoritative; this module never derives or
+ratchets either value.  Protection therefore continues while the Alpaca order
+remains active, including while the application engine is offline.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.risk.stop_policy import (
+    BrokerProtectionCapabilities,
+    ProtectionMode,
+    ProtectionPolicy,
+)
+from mike_trade.runtime import ExecutionMode
+
+__all__ = [
+    "NativeTrailingState",
+    "build_trailing_stop_request",
+    "submit_trailing_stop",
+    "replace_trailing_stop",
+    "cancel_trailing_stop",
+    "parse_trailing_order_state",
+]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_TRAILING_STOP = "TRAILING_STOP"
+_LINKED_ORDER_CLASSES = frozenset({"bracket", "oto", "oco"})
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class NativeTrailingState:
+    """One broker-confirmed snapshot of continuous native trailing protection."""
+
+    order_id: str
+    client_order_id: str
+    status: str
+    broker_status: str
+    hwm: Decimal | None
+    stop_price: Decimal | None
+    trail_price: Decimal | None
+    trail_percent: Decimal | None
+    time_in_force: str
+    qty: Decimal
+    filled_qty: Decimal
+    protected_quantity: Decimal
+    updated_at: datetime
+    behavior: str = field(default="continuous_broker_managed", init=False)
+
+    @property
+    def condition(self) -> str:
+        """Provider-neutral protection condition (an alias for ``status``)."""
+
+        return self.status
+
+    @property
+    def high_water_mark(self) -> Decimal | None:
+        """Readable alias for Alpaca's ``hwm`` response field."""
+
+        return self.hwm
+
+
+def _text(value: Any, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _decimal(
+    value: Any,
+    *,
+    field: str,
+    positive: bool = False,
+    optional: bool = False,
+    unparseable_is_none: bool = False,
+) -> Decimal | None:
+    if value is None:
+        if optional:
+            return None
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} is required")
+    try:
+        if isinstance(value, bool) or isinstance(value, float):
+            raise ValueError
+        if isinstance(value, Decimal):
+            parsed = value
+        elif isinstance(value, int):
+            parsed = Decimal(value)
+        elif isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
+            parsed = Decimal(value.strip())
+        else:
+            raise ValueError
+    except (InvalidOperation, ValueError):
+        if unparseable_is_none:
+            return None
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a valid Decimal") from None
+    if not parsed.is_finite() or (positive and parsed <= _ZERO):
+        if unparseable_is_none:
+            return None
+        requirement = "a finite positive Decimal" if positive else "a finite Decimal"
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be {requirement}")
+    return parsed
+
+
+def _field(raw_order: Mapping[str, Any] | object, *names: str) -> Any:
+    if isinstance(raw_order, Mapping):
+        for name in names:
+            if name in raw_order:
+                return raw_order[name]
+    else:
+        for name in names:
+            if hasattr(raw_order, name):
+                return getattr(raw_order, name)
+    return None
+
+
+def _utc_timestamp(value: Any, *, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if isinstance(value, datetime):
+        parsed = value
+    elif isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
+        text = value.strip()
+        if text.endswith("Z"):
+            text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
+        try:
+            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
+        except ValueError:
+            raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid timestamp") from None
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a timezone-aware timestamp")
+    if parsed.tzinfo is None or parsed.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
+    return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _mode(value: ExecutionMode | str) -> ExecutionMode:
+    if isinstance(value, ExecutionMode):
+        return value
+    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
+    if isinstance(raw, str):
+        try:
+            return ExecutionMode(raw.strip().upper())
+        except ValueError:
+            pass
+    raise ValueError("execution_mode must be BACKTEST, SHADOW, PAPER, or LIVE")
+
+
+def _validate_fractional(
+    qty: Decimal,
+    policy: ProtectionPolicy,
+    capabilities: BrokerProtectionCapabilities | None,
+    execution_mode: ExecutionMode | str,
+) -> None:
+    if qty == qty.to_integral_value():
+        return
+    if not isinstance(capabilities, BrokerProtectionCapabilities):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "fractional native trailing quantity requires injected "
+            "BrokerProtectionCapabilities"
+        )
+    if not policy.allow_fractional_protection:
+        raise ValueError("fractional native trailing protection is not enabled by policy")
+    if policy.documented_fractional_risk_ack is None:
+        raise ValueError("fractional native trailing protection requires a risk acknowledgement")
+    combination = (_TRAILING_STOP, policy.time_in_force)
+    if combination not in capabilities.fractional_combinations:
+        raise ValueError("fractional trailing/TIF combination is not supported")
+    if (
+        _mode(execution_mode) is ExecutionMode.LIVE
+        and combination not in capabilities.paper_proven_fractional_combinations
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("fractional trailing/TIF combination is not paper_proven for LIVE")
+
+
+def build_trailing_stop_request(
+    symbol: str,
+    qty: Decimal,
+    policy: ProtectionPolicy,
+    client_order_id: str,
+    *,
+    capabilities: BrokerProtectionCapabilities | None = None,
+    execution_mode: ExecutionMode | str = ExecutionMode.PAPER,
+    side: str = "sell",
+    order_class: str = "simple",
+) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Build a validated standalone Alpaca native trailing-stop SELL request."""
+
+    cleaned_symbol = _text(symbol, field="symbol").upper()
+    if any(character.isspace() for character in cleaned_symbol):
+        raise ValueError("symbol must not contain whitespace")
+    quantity = _decimal(qty, field="qty", positive=True)
+    assert isinstance(quantity, Decimal)
+    if not isinstance(policy, ProtectionPolicy):
+        raise TypeError("policy must be ProtectionPolicy")
+    if policy.mode is not ProtectionMode.TRAILING_NATIVE:
+        raise ValueError("policy mode must be TRAILING_NATIVE")
+
+    normalized_side = _text(getattr(side, "value", side), field="side").lower()
+    if normalized_side != "sell":
+        raise ValueError("native trailing protection is long-only and side must be SELL")
+    normalized_class = _text(
+        getattr(order_class, "value", order_class), field="order_class"
+    ).lower()
+    if policy.linked or normalized_class in _LINKED_ORDER_CLASSES:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Alpaca trailing stops must be standalone; bracket, OTO, and OCO "
+            "order classes are not allowed"
+        )
+    if normalized_class != "simple":
+        raise ValueError("Alpaca trailing stops require order_class simple")
+
+    trail_count = int(policy.trail_price is not None) + int(
+        policy.trail_percent is not None
+    )
+    if trail_count != 1:
+        raise ValueError("exactly one of trail_price or trail_percent is required")
+    _validate_fractional(quantity, policy, capabilities, execution_mode)
+
+    request = {
+        "symbol": cleaned_symbol,
+        "qty": str(quantity),
+        "side": "sell",
+        "type": "trailing_stop",
+        "time_in_force": policy.time_in_force.value.lower(),
+        "order_class": "simple",
+        "client_order_id": _text(client_order_id, field="client_order_id"),
+    }
+    if policy.trail_price is not None:
+        request["trail_price"] = str(policy.trail_price)
+    else:
+        assert policy.trail_percent is not None
+        request["trail_percent"] = str(policy.trail_percent)
+    return request
+
+
+def _submit(client: object, request: Mapping[str, str]) -> Any:
+    post = getattr(client, "post", None)
+    if callable(post):
+        return post("/v2/orders", json_body=dict(request), params=None)
+    submit = getattr(client, "submit_order", None)
+    if callable(submit):
+        return submit(dict(request))
+    if callable(client):
+        return client(dict(request))
+    raise TypeError("client must provide post(), submit_order(), or be callable")
+
+
+def submit_trailing_stop(
+    client: object,
+    symbol: str,
+    qty: Decimal,
+    policy: ProtectionPolicy,
+    client_order_id: str,
+    *,
+    capabilities: BrokerProtectionCapabilities | None = None,
+    execution_mode: ExecutionMode | str = ExecutionMode.PAPER,
+    side: str = "sell",
+    order_class: str = "simple",
+) -> NativeTrailingState:
+    """Submit through an injected Alpaca HTTP client/port and parse its response."""
+
+    request = build_trailing_stop_request(
+        symbol,
+        qty,
+        policy,
+        client_order_id,
+        capabilities=capabilities,
+        execution_mode=execution_mode,
+        side=side,
+        order_class=order_class,
+    )

+
+
+def replace_trailing_stop(
+    client: object,
+    order_id: str,
+    *,
+    qty: Decimal | None = None,
+    trail_price: Decimal | None = None,
+    trail_percent: Decimal | None = None,
+    client_order_id: str | None = None,
+) -> NativeTrailingState:
+    """Replace mutable fields through an injected client; never changes order class."""
+
+    cleaned_order_id = _text(order_id, field="order_id")
+    if trail_price is not None and trail_percent is not None:
+        raise ValueError("replace at most one of trail_price or trail_percent")
+    body: dict[str, str] = {}
+    if qty is not None:
+        parsed_qty = _decimal(qty, field="qty", positive=True)
+        assert isinstance(parsed_qty, Decimal)
+        body["qty"] = str(parsed_qty)
+    for field, value in (("trail_price", trail_price), ("trail_percent", trail_percent)):
+        if value is not None:
+            parsed = _decimal(value, field=field, positive=True)
+            assert isinstance(parsed, Decimal)
+            body[field] = str(parsed)
+    if client_order_id is not None:
+        body["client_order_id"] = _text(client_order_id, field="client_order_id")
+    if not body:
+        raise ValueError("a replacement qty, trail value, or client_order_id is required")
+
+    patch = getattr(client, "patch", None)
+    if callable(patch):
+        raw = patch(f"/v2/orders/{cleaned_order_id}", json_body=body, params=None)
+    else:
+        replace = getattr(client, "replace_order", None)
+        if not callable(replace):
+            raise TypeError("client must provide patch() or replace_order()")
+        raw = replace(cleaned_order_id, body)
+    return parse_trailing_order_state(raw)
+
+
+def cancel_trailing_stop(client: object, order_id: str) -> Any:
+    """Cancel through an injected client/port without constructing credentials."""
+
+    cleaned_order_id = _text(order_id, field="order_id")
+    delete = getattr(client, "delete", None)
+    if callable(delete):
+        return delete(f"/v2/orders/{cleaned_order_id}", params=None)
+    cancel = getattr(client, "cancel_order", None)
+    if callable(cancel):
+        return cancel(cleaned_order_id)
+    raise TypeError("client must provide delete() or cancel_order()")
+
+
+def _condition(broker_status: str, hwm: Decimal | None, stop_price: Decimal | None) -> str:
+    if broker_status == "accepted":
+        return "ACTIVE" if hwm is not None and stop_price is not None else "UNCONFIRMED"
+    if broker_status in {"new", "pending_new"}:
+        return "PENDING"
+    if broker_status in {"replaced", "pending_replace"}:
+        return "UPDATING"
+    if broker_status in {"filled", "partially_filled"}:
+        return "TRIGGERED"
+    if broker_status in {"expired", "done_for_day"}:
+        return "EXPIRED"
+    if broker_status in {"canceled", "cancelled", "rejected"}:
+        # A coordinator may supersede this only when it has separately recorded
+        # an intentional coordinated exit.
+        return "UNPROTECTED"
+    return "UNCONFIRMED"
+

+def parse_trailing_order_state(raw_order: Mapping[str, Any] | object) -> NativeTrailingState:
+    """Parse an authoritative Alpaca native trailing-order snapshot.

+        raise TypeError("raw_order is required")

+    )

+    time_in_force = _text(
+        _field(raw_order, "time_in_force"), field="time_in_force"
+    ).lower()

+    filled_qty = _decimal(_field(raw_order, "filled_qty"), field="filled_qty")

+    if filled_qty < _ZERO:
+        raise ValueError("filled_qty must be >= 0")
+    if filled_qty > qty:
+        raise ValueError("filled_qty must not exceed qty")
+
+    hwm = _decimal(
+        _field(raw_order, "hwm"),
+        field="hwm",
+        positive=True,
+        optional=True,
+        unparseable_is_none=True,
+    )
+    stop_price = _decimal(
+        _field(raw_order, "stop_price"),
+        field="stop_price",
+        positive=True,
+        optional=True,
+        unparseable_is_none=True,
+    )
+    trail_price = _decimal(
+        _field(raw_order, "trail_price"), field="trail_price", positive=True, optional=True
+    )
+    trail_percent = _decimal(
+        _field(raw_order, "trail_percent"),
+        field="trail_percent",
+        positive=True,
+        optional=True,
+    )
+    if (trail_price is None) == (trail_percent is None):
+        raise ValueError("broker trailing order must contain exactly one trail value")
+    updated_at = _utc_timestamp(
+        _field(raw_order, "updated_at"), field="updated_at"
+    )
+    return NativeTrailingState(
+        order_id=order_id,
+        client_order_id=client_order_id,
+        status=_condition(broker_status, hwm, stop_price),
+        broker_status=broker_status,
+        hwm=hwm,
+        stop_price=stop_price,
+        trail_price=trail_price,
+        trail_percent=trail_percent,
+        time_in_force=time_in_force,
+        qty=qty,
+        filled_qty=filled_qty,
+        protected_quantity=qty - filled_qty,

+    )

+"""Alpaca standalone native trailing-stop adapter.
+
+Native trailing protection is continuous and broker managed.  Alpaca's ``hwm``
+and ``stop_price`` fields are authoritative; this module never derives or
+ratchets either value.  Protection therefore continues while the Alpaca order
+remains active, including while the application engine is offline.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.risk.stop_policy import (
+    BrokerProtectionCapabilities,
+    ProtectionMode,
+    ProtectionPolicy,
+)
+from mike_trade.runtime import ExecutionMode
+
+__all__ = [
+    "NativeTrailingState",
+    "build_trailing_stop_request",
+    "submit_trailing_stop",
+    "replace_trailing_stop",
+    "cancel_trailing_stop",
+    "parse_trailing_order_state",
+]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_TRAILING_STOP = "TRAILING_STOP"
+_LINKED_ORDER_CLASSES = frozenset({"bracket", "oto", "oco"})
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class NativeTrailingState:
+    """One broker-confirmed snapshot of continuous native trailing protection."""
+
+    order_id: str
+    client_order_id: str
+    status: str
+    broker_status: str
+    hwm: Decimal | None
+    stop_price: Decimal | None
+    trail_price: Decimal | None
+    trail_percent: Decimal | None
+    time_in_force: str
+    qty: Decimal
+    filled_qty: Decimal
+    protected_quantity: Decimal
+    updated_at: datetime
+    behavior: str = field(default="continuous_broker_managed", init=False)
+
+    @property
+    def condition(self) -> str:
+        """Provider-neutral protection condition (an alias for ``status``)."""
+
+        return self.status
+
+    @property
+    def high_water_mark(self) -> Decimal | None:
+        """Readable alias for Alpaca's ``hwm`` response field."""
+
+        return self.hwm
+
+
+def _text(value: Any, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _decimal(
+    value: Any,
+    *,
+    field: str,
+    positive: bool = False,
+    optional: bool = False,
+    unparseable_is_none: bool = False,
+) -> Decimal | None:
+    if value is None:
+        if optional:
+            return None
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} is required")
+    try:
+        if isinstance(value, bool) or isinstance(value, float):
+            raise ValueError
+        if isinstance(value, Decimal):
+            parsed = value
+        elif isinstance(value, int):
+            parsed = Decimal(value)
+        elif isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
+            parsed = Decimal(value.strip())
+        else:
+            raise ValueError
+    except (InvalidOperation, ValueError):
+        if unparseable_is_none:
+            return None
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a valid Decimal") from None
+    if not parsed.is_finite() or (positive and parsed <= _ZERO):
+        if unparseable_is_none:
+            return None
+        requirement = "a finite positive Decimal" if positive else "a finite Decimal"
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be {requirement}")
+    return parsed
+
+
+def _field(raw_order: Mapping[str, Any] | object, *names: str) -> Any:
+    if isinstance(raw_order, Mapping):
+        for name in names:
+            if name in raw_order:
+                return raw_order[name]
+    else:
+        for name in names:
+            if hasattr(raw_order, name):
+                return getattr(raw_order, name)
+    return None
+
+
+def _utc_timestamp(value: Any, *, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if isinstance(value, datetime):
+        parsed = value
+    elif isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
+        text = value.strip()
+        if text.endswith("Z"):
+            text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
+        try:
+            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
+        except ValueError:
+            raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid timestamp") from None
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a timezone-aware timestamp")
+    if parsed.tzinfo is None or parsed.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
+    return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _mode(value: ExecutionMode | str) -> ExecutionMode:
+    if isinstance(value, ExecutionMode):
+        return value
+    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
+    if isinstance(raw, str):
+        try:
+            return ExecutionMode(raw.strip().upper())
+        except ValueError:
+            pass
+    raise ValueError("execution_mode must be BACKTEST, SHADOW, PAPER, or LIVE")
+
+
+def _validate_fractional(
+    qty: Decimal,
+    policy: ProtectionPolicy,
+    capabilities: BrokerProtectionCapabilities | None,
+    execution_mode: ExecutionMode | str,
+) -> None:
+    if qty == qty.to_integral_value():
+        return
+    if not isinstance(capabilities, BrokerProtectionCapabilities):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "fractional native trailing quantity requires injected "
+            "BrokerProtectionCapabilities"
+        )
+    if not policy.allow_fractional_protection:
+        raise ValueError("fractional native trailing protection is not enabled by policy")
+    if policy.documented_fractional_risk_ack is None:
+        raise ValueError("fractional native trailing protection requires a risk acknowledgement")
+    combination = (_TRAILING_STOP, policy.time_in_force)
+    if combination not in capabilities.fractional_combinations:
+        raise ValueError("fractional trailing/TIF combination is not supported")
+    if (
+        _mode(execution_mode) is ExecutionMode.LIVE
+        and combination not in capabilities.paper_proven_fractional_combinations
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("fractional trailing/TIF combination is not paper_proven for LIVE")
+
+
+def build_trailing_stop_request(
+    symbol: str,
+    qty: Decimal,
+    policy: ProtectionPolicy,
+    client_order_id: str,
+    *,
+    capabilities: BrokerProtectionCapabilities | None = None,
+    execution_mode: ExecutionMode | str = ExecutionMode.PAPER,
+    side: str = "sell",
+    order_class: str = "simple",
+) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Build a validated standalone Alpaca native trailing-stop SELL request."""
+
+    cleaned_symbol = _text(symbol, field="symbol").upper()
+    if any(character.isspace() for character in cleaned_symbol):
+        raise ValueError("symbol must not contain whitespace")
+    quantity = _decimal(qty, field="qty", positive=True)
+    assert isinstance(quantity, Decimal)
+    if not isinstance(policy, ProtectionPolicy):
+        raise TypeError("policy must be ProtectionPolicy")
+    if policy.mode is not ProtectionMode.TRAILING_NATIVE:
+        raise ValueError("policy mode must be TRAILING_NATIVE")
+
+    normalized_side = _text(getattr(side, "value", side), field="side").lower()
+    if normalized_side != "sell":
+        raise ValueError("native trailing protection is long-only and side must be SELL")
+    normalized_class = _text(
+        getattr(order_class, "value", order_class), field="order_class"
+    ).lower()
+    if policy.linked or normalized_class in _LINKED_ORDER_CLASSES:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Alpaca trailing stops must be standalone; bracket, OTO, and OCO "
+            "order classes are not allowed"
+        )
+    if normalized_class != "simple":
+        raise ValueError("Alpaca trailing stops require order_class simple")
+
+    trail_count = int(policy.trail_price is not None) + int(
+        policy.trail_percent is not None
+    )
+    if trail_count != 1:
+        raise ValueError("exactly one of trail_price or trail_percent is required")
+    _validate_fractional(quantity, policy, capabilities, execution_mode)
+
+    request = {
+        "symbol": cleaned_symbol,
+        "qty": str(quantity),
+        "side": "sell",
+        "type": "trailing_stop",
+        "time_in_force": policy.time_in_force.value.lower(),
+        "order_class": "simple",
+        "client_order_id": _text(client_order_id, field="client_order_id"),
+    }
+    if policy.trail_price is not None:
+        request["trail_price"] = str(policy.trail_price)
+    else:
+        assert policy.trail_percent is not None
+        request["trail_percent"] = str(policy.trail_percent)
+    return request
+
+
+def _submit(client: object, request: Mapping[str, str]) -> Any:
+    post = getattr(client, "post", None)
+    if callable(post):
+        return post("/v2/orders", json_body=dict(request), params=None)
+    submit = getattr(client, "submit_order", None)
+    if callable(submit):
+        return submit(dict(request))
+    if callable(client):
+        return client(dict(request))
+    raise TypeError("client must provide post(), submit_order(), or be callable")
+
+
+def submit_trailing_stop(
+    client: object,
+    symbol: str,
+    qty: Decimal,
+    policy: ProtectionPolicy,
+    client_order_id: str,
+    *,
+    capabilities: BrokerProtectionCapabilities | None = None,
+    execution_mode: ExecutionMode | str = ExecutionMode.PAPER,
+    side: str = "sell",
+    order_class: str = "simple",
+) -> NativeTrailingState:
+    """Submit through an injected Alpaca HTTP client/port and parse its response."""
+
+    request = build_trailing_stop_request(
+        symbol,
+        qty,
+        policy,
+        client_order_id,
+        capabilities=capabilities,
+        execution_mode=execution_mode,
+        side=side,
+        order_class=order_class,
+    )
+    return parse_trailing_order_state(_submit(client, request))
+
+
+def replace_trailing_stop(
+    client: object,
+    order_id: str,
+    *,
+    qty: Decimal | None = None,
+    trail_price: Decimal | None = None,
+    trail_percent: Decimal | None = None,
+    client_order_id: str | None = None,
+) -> NativeTrailingState:
+    """Replace mutable fields through an injected client; never changes order class."""
+
+    cleaned_order_id = _text(order_id, field="order_id")
+    if trail_price is not None and trail_percent is not None:
+        raise ValueError("replace at most one of trail_price or trail_percent")
+    body: dict[str, str] = {}
+    if qty is not None:
+        parsed_qty = _decimal(qty, field="qty", positive=True)
+        assert isinstance(parsed_qty, Decimal)
+        body["qty"] = str(parsed_qty)
+    for field, value in (("trail_price", trail_price), ("trail_percent", trail_percent)):
+        if value is not None:
+            parsed = _decimal(value, field=field, positive=True)
+            assert isinstance(parsed, Decimal)
+            body[field] = str(parsed)
+    if client_order_id is not None:
+        body["client_order_id"] = _text(client_order_id, field="client_order_id")
+    if not body:
+        raise ValueError("a replacement qty, trail value, or client_order_id is required")
+
+    patch = getattr(client, "patch", None)
+    if callable(patch):
+        raw = patch(f"/v2/orders/{cleaned_order_id}", json_body=body, params=None)
+    else:
+        replace = getattr(client, "replace_order", None)
+        if not callable(replace):
+            raise TypeError("client must provide patch() or replace_order()")
+        raw = replace(cleaned_order_id, body)
+    return parse_trailing_order_state(raw)
+
+
+def cancel_trailing_stop(client: object, order_id: str) -> Any:
+    """Cancel through an injected client/port without constructing credentials."""
+
+    cleaned_order_id = _text(order_id, field="order_id")
+    delete = getattr(client, "delete", None)
+    if callable(delete):
+        return delete(f"/v2/orders/{cleaned_order_id}", params=None)
+    cancel = getattr(client, "cancel_order", None)
+    if callable(cancel):
+        return cancel(cleaned_order_id)
+    raise TypeError("client must provide delete() or cancel_order()")
+
+
+def _condition(broker_status: str, hwm: Decimal | None, stop_price: Decimal | None) -> str:
+    if broker_status == "accepted":
+        return "ACTIVE" if hwm is not None and stop_price is not None else "UNCONFIRMED"
+    if broker_status in {"new", "pending_new"}:
+        return "PENDING"
+    if broker_status in {"replaced", "pending_replace"}:
+        return "UPDATING"
+    if broker_status in {"filled", "partially_filled"}:
+        return "TRIGGERED"
+    if broker_status in {"expired", "done_for_day"}:
+        return "EXPIRED"
+    if broker_status in {"canceled", "cancelled", "rejected"}:
+        # A coordinator may supersede this only when it has separately recorded
+        # an intentional coordinated exit.
+        return "UNPROTECTED"
+    return "UNCONFIRMED"
+
+
+def parse_trailing_order_state(raw_order: Mapping[str, Any] | object) -> NativeTrailingState:
+    """Parse an authoritative Alpaca native trailing-order snapshot.
+
+    Missing or malformed broker ``hwm``/``stop_price`` fields are retained as
+    ``None``.  An otherwise active accepted order is then ``UNCONFIRMED``;
+    neither value is ever fabricated from market data or a prior snapshot.
+    """
+
+    if raw_order is None:
+        raise TypeError("raw_order is required")
+    order_id = _text(_field(raw_order, "id", "order_id"), field="order id")
+    client_order_id = _text(
+        _field(raw_order, "client_order_id"), field="client_order_id"
+    )
+    broker_status = _text(_field(raw_order, "status"), field="status").lower()
+    time_in_force = _text(
+        _field(raw_order, "time_in_force"), field="time_in_force"
+    ).lower()
+    qty = _decimal(_field(raw_order, "qty"), field="qty", positive=True)
+    filled_qty = _decimal(_field(raw_order, "filled_qty"), field="filled_qty")
+    assert isinstance(qty, Decimal) and isinstance(filled_qty, Decimal)
+    if filled_qty < _ZERO:
+        raise ValueError("filled_qty must be >= 0")
+    if filled_qty > qty:
+        raise ValueError("filled_qty must not exceed qty")
+
+    hwm = _decimal(
+        _field(raw_order, "hwm"),
+        field="hwm",
+        positive=True,
+        optional=True,
+        unparseable_is_none=True,
+    )
+    stop_price = _decimal(
+        _field(raw_order, "stop_price"),
+        field="stop_price",
+        positive=True,
+        optional=True,
+        unparseable_is_none=True,
+    )
+    trail_price = _decimal(
+        _field(raw_order, "trail_price"), field="trail_price", positive=True, optional=True
+    )
+    trail_percent = _decimal(
+        _field(raw_order, "trail_percent"),
+        field="trail_percent",
+        positive=True,
+        optional=True,
+    )
+    if (trail_price is None) == (trail_percent is None):
+        raise ValueError("broker trailing order must contain exactly one trail value")
+    updated_at = _utc_timestamp(
+        _field(raw_order, "updated_at"), field="updated_at"
+    )
+    return NativeTrailingState(
+        order_id=order_id,
+        client_order_id=client_order_id,
+        status=_condition(broker_status, hwm, stop_price),
+        broker_status=broker_status,
+        hwm=hwm,
+        stop_price=stop_price,
+        trail_price=trail_price,
+        trail_percent=trail_percent,
+        time_in_force=time_in_force,
+        qty=qty,
+        filled_qty=filled_qty,
+        protected_quantity=qty - filled_qty,
+        updated_at=updated_at,
+    )

def make_client_order_id(
    mode: AlpacaEnvironment | str | Enum,
    account_fingerprint: str,
    cycle_id: str,
    purpose: OrderPurpose | str | Enum,
    attempt: int,
) -> str:
    """Return a deterministic, audit-inspectable ID no longer than 48 chars.

    The 128-bit truncated SHA-256 digest covers length-prefixed canonical input,
    while purpose and base-36 attempt remain directly inspectable.
    """

    raw_mode = getattr(mode, "value", mode)
    if not isinstance(raw_mode, str) or not raw_mode.strip():
        raise ValueError("mode must be a non-empty string or enum")
    fingerprint = _require_text(account_fingerprint, field="account_fingerprint")
    cycle = _require_text(cycle_id, field="cycle_id")
    resolved_purpose = _purpose(purpose)
    if isinstance(attempt, bool) or not isinstance(attempt, int) or attempt < 0:
        raise ValueError("attempt must be an int >= 0")
    components = (
        raw_mode.strip().upper(),
        fingerprint,
        cycle,
        resolved_purpose.value,
        str(attempt),
    )
    canonical = "".join(f"{len(item)}:{item}" for item in components)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:32]
    result = f"mt1-{_PURPOSE_CODES[resolved_purpose]}-{_base36(attempt)}-{digest}"
    if len(result) > 48:  # defensive: current format is at most 47 for bounded ints
        raise ValueError("attempt is too large for Alpaca's client_order_id limit")
    return result


def parse_client_order_id(client_order_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Inspect an ID generated by :func:`make_client_order_id`.

    Hashed identity inputs cannot be reversed; the result exposes the format
    version, purpose, attempt, and digest for audit and comparison.
    """

    value = _require_text(client_order_id, field="client_order_id")
    match = _CLIENT_ORDER_ID_RE.fullmatch(value)
    if match is None or match.group("purpose") not in _CODE_PURPOSES:
        raise ValueError("not a mike_trade Alpaca client_order_id")
    return {
        "version": 1,
        "purpose": _CODE_PURPOSES[match.group("purpose")],
        "attempt": int(match.group("attempt"), 36),
        "digest": match.group("digest"),
        "client_order_id": value,
    }

        object.__setattr__(self, "kind", kind)
        object.__setattr__(self, "reference", _require_nonempty(self.reference, field="reference"))
        object.__setattr__(self, "recorded_on", _ensure_date(self.recorded_on, field="recorded_on"))
        if not isinstance(self.note, str):
            raise ValueError("note must be a string")
        object.__setattr__(self, "note", self.note)


def _validated_field(value: Any, *, field: str, allowed: frozenset[str]) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a string; got {type(value).__name__}")
    normalized = value.strip().lower()
    if normalized not in allowed:
        raise ValueError(f"unsupported {field}: {value!r}; expected one of {sorted(allowed)}")
    return normalized

    ``sizing`` is ``whole`` (whole-share qty), ``fractional`` (fractional qty),
    or ``notional``. ``side`` is ``buy``, ``sell`` (long exit), or ``short``
    (short sale, always unsupported on the long-only desk). ``operation`` is
    ``submit`` or ``replace``.

        )
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "order_class",
            _validated_field(self.order_class, field="order_class", allowed=_ORDER_CLASSES),
        )
        object.__setattr__(

    """Structural verdict, or None when the descriptor is structurally possible."""
    if descriptor.side == "short":
        return CapabilityStatus.UNSUPPORTED
    if descriptor.order_type == "trailing_stop" and descriptor.order_class != "simple":
        return CapabilityStatus.UNSUPPORTED
    if descriptor.operation == "replace" and descriptor.sizing == "notional":

    """Operator-readable reason for a structural UNSUPPORTED verdict."""
    if descriptor.side == "short":

        return (
            "trailing_stop with order_class other than simple is never available: "
            "Alpaca supports standalone trailing stops only"
        )
    if descriptor.operation == "replace" and descriptor.sizing == "notional":
        return "notional orders cannot be replaced: Alpaca rejects notional replace"
    return None

Capability declarations are intentionally explicit and default to unsupported.

_ZERO = Decimal("0")
_STOP_MARKET = "STOP_MARKET"
_STOP_LIMIT = "STOP_LIMIT"
_TRAILING_STOP = "TRAILING_STOP"
_TRAIL_PRICE = "TRAIL_PRICE"
_TRAIL_PERCENT = "TRAIL_PERCENT"
_ALLOWED = "ALLOWED"
_REJECTED = "REJECTED"

_RISK_NOTES = (
    "A stop trigger price is not a guaranteed execution price or maximum loss.",
    "A stop-limit order may not fill.",
    "DAY TIF expires and leaves an overnight residual unless protection is renewed.",
)


class ProtectionMode(StrEnum):
    FIXED = "FIXED"
    TRAILING_NATIVE = "TRAILING_NATIVE"
    TRAILING_STEPPED = "TRAILING_STEPPED"


def _positive_decimal(value: object, name: str) -> Decimal | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be Decimal")
    if not value.is_finite() or value <= _ZERO:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a finite positive Decimal")
    return value


def _order_semantics(value: object) -> str:
    raw = value.value if isinstance(value, OrderType) else value
    if not isinstance(raw, str):
        raise TypeError("order_semantics must be STOP_MARKET or STOP_LIMIT")
    normalized = raw.strip().upper()
    if normalized == OrderType.STOP.value:
        normalized = _STOP_MARKET
    if normalized not in {_STOP_MARKET, _STOP_LIMIT}:
        raise ValueError("order_semantics must be STOP_MARKET or STOP_LIMIT")
    return normalized


def _tif(value: object) -> TimeInForce:
    if isinstance(value, TimeInForce):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        try:
            return TimeInForce(value.strip().upper())
        except ValueError:
            pass
    raise ValueError("time_in_force must be DAY or GTC")


def _mode_value(value: object) -> str:
    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or raw.upper() not in {item.value for item in ExecutionMode}:
        raise ValueError("execution_mode must be BACKTEST, SHADOW, PAPER, or LIVE")
    return raw.upper()


def _normalize_order_types(values: Iterable[object], name: str) -> frozenset[str]:
    try:
        normalized: set[str] = set()
        for value in values:
            raw = value.value if isinstance(value, OrderType) else value
            if isinstance(raw, str) and raw.strip().upper() == _TRAILING_STOP:
                normalized.add(_TRAILING_STOP)
            else:
                normalized.add(_order_semantics(value))
        return frozenset(normalized)
    except TypeError as exc:
        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be an iterable of order types") from exc


def _normalize_tifs(values: Iterable[object], name: str) -> frozenset[TimeInForce]:
    try:
        return frozenset(_tif(value) for value in values)
    except TypeError as exc:
        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be an iterable of TIF values") from exc


def _normalize_combinations(
    values: Iterable[tuple[object, object]], name: str
) -> frozenset[tuple[str, TimeInForce]]:
    result: set[tuple[str, TimeInForce]] = set()
    try:
        for order_type, tif in values:
            normalized = _normalize_order_types((order_type,), name)
            result.add((next(iter(normalized)), _tif(tif)))
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise type(exc)(f"invalid {name}: {exc}") from exc
    return frozenset(result)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ProtectionPolicy:
    """One long-position protection rule.

    ``fixed_reference`` is a provider-neutral reference name.  The default is
    the broker-confirmed average fill; configured systems may use another
    documented reference and resolve it before broker submission.
    """

    mode: ProtectionMode
    required: bool = True
    order_semantics: str | OrderType = _STOP_MARKET
    limit_offset: Decimal | None = None
    fixed_reference: str = "CONFIRMED_FILL_PRICE"
    distance_percent: Decimal | None = None
    distance_usd: Decimal | None = None
    atr_multiple: Decimal | None = None
    support_level: Decimal | None = None
    trail_percent: Decimal | None = None
    trail_price: Decimal | None = None
    time_in_force: TimeInForce | str = TimeInForce.GTC
    allow_fractional_protection: bool = False
    documented_fractional_risk_ack: str | None = None
    linked: bool = False

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not isinstance(self.mode, ProtectionMode):
            try:
                object.__setattr__(self, "mode", ProtectionMode(str(self.mode).upper()))
            except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
                raise ValueError("mode must be a ProtectionMode") from exc
        for name in ("required", "allow_fractional_protection", "linked"):
            if not isinstance(getattr(self, name), bool):
                raise TypeError(f"{name} must be bool")
        object.__setattr__(self, "order_semantics", _order_semantics(self.order_semantics))
        object.__setattr__(self, "time_in_force", _tif(self.time_in_force))
        if not isinstance(self.fixed_reference, str) or not self.fixed_reference.strip():
            raise ValueError("fixed_reference must be a non-empty string")
        object.__setattr__(self, "fixed_reference", self.fixed_reference.strip().upper())

        for name in (
            "limit_offset",
            "distance_percent",
            "distance_usd",
            "atr_multiple",
            "support_level",
            "trail_percent",
            "trail_price",
        ):
            object.__setattr__(self, name, _positive_decimal(getattr(self, name), name))

        if self.order_semantics == _STOP_LIMIT and self.limit_offset is None:
            raise ValueError("STOP_LIMIT requires limit_offset")
        if self.order_semantics == _STOP_MARKET and self.limit_offset is not None:
            raise ValueError("STOP_MARKET does not accept limit_offset")

        fixed_count = sum(
            value is not None
            for value in (
                self.distance_percent,
                self.distance_usd,
                self.atr_multiple,
                self.support_level,
            )
        )
        trail_count = int(self.trail_percent is not None) + int(self.trail_price is not None)
        if self.mode is ProtectionMode.FIXED:
            if fixed_count != 1:
                raise ValueError("FIXED requires exactly one distance definition")
            if trail_count:
                raise ValueError("FIXED does not accept native trailing distances")
        elif self.mode is ProtectionMode.TRAILING_NATIVE:
            if trail_count != 1:
                raise ValueError(
                    "TRAILING_NATIVE requires exactly one of trail_price or trail_percent"
                )
            if fixed_count:
                raise ValueError("TRAILING_NATIVE does not accept fixed distances")

        ack = self.documented_fractional_risk_ack
        if ack is not None:
            if not isinstance(ack, str) or not ack.strip():
                raise ValueError("documented_fractional_risk_ack must be non-empty when set")
            object.__setattr__(self, "documented_fractional_risk_ack", ack.strip())


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class BrokerProtectionCapabilities:
    """Explicit supported and paper-proven protective-order combinations."""

    supported_order_types: frozenset[str | OrderType] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
    paper_proven_order_types: frozenset[str | OrderType] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
    standalone_trailing_parameters: frozenset[str] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
    paper_proven_standalone_trailing_parameters: frozenset[str] = field(
        default_factory=frozenset
    )
    fractional_combinations: frozenset[tuple[str | OrderType, TimeInForce | str]] = field(
        default_factory=frozenset
    )
    paper_proven_fractional_combinations: frozenset[
        tuple[str | OrderType, TimeInForce | str]
    ] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
    supported_tifs: frozenset[TimeInForce | str] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
    paper_proven_tifs: frozenset[TimeInForce | str] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
    linked_order_types: frozenset[str | OrderType] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
    paper_proven_linked_order_types: frozenset[str | OrderType] = field(
        default_factory=frozenset
    )
    linked_trailing_parameters: frozenset[str] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
    paper_proven_linked_trailing_parameters: frozenset[str] = field(
        default_factory=frozenset
    )

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for name in (
            "supported_order_types",
            "paper_proven_order_types",
            "fractional_combinations",
            "paper_proven_fractional_combinations",
            "supported_tifs",
            "paper_proven_tifs",
            "linked_order_types",
            "paper_proven_linked_order_types",
            "standalone_trailing_parameters",
            "paper_proven_standalone_trailing_parameters",
            "linked_trailing_parameters",
            "paper_proven_linked_trailing_parameters",
        ):
            if not isinstance(getattr(self, name), frozenset):
                raise TypeError(f"{name} must be a frozenset")

        for name in (
            "supported_order_types",
            "paper_proven_order_types",
            "linked_order_types",
            "paper_proven_linked_order_types",
        ):
            object.__setattr__(self, name, _normalize_order_types(getattr(self, name), name))
        for name in ("supported_tifs", "paper_proven_tifs"):
            object.__setattr__(self, name, _normalize_tifs(getattr(self, name), name))
        for name in ("fractional_combinations", "paper_proven_fractional_combinations"):
            object.__setattr__(self, name, _normalize_combinations(getattr(self, name), name))
        for name in (
            "standalone_trailing_parameters",
            "paper_proven_standalone_trailing_parameters",
            "linked_trailing_parameters",
            "paper_proven_linked_trailing_parameters",
        ):
            normalized = frozenset(str(value).strip().upper() for value in getattr(self, name))
            if not normalized <= {_TRAIL_PRICE, _TRAIL_PERCENT}:
                raise ValueError(f"{name} contains an unsupported trailing parameter")
            object.__setattr__(self, name, normalized)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ProtectionEligibility:
    status: str
    reason_code: str | None
    risk_notes: tuple[str, ...]
    entry_allowed: bool

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.status not in {_ALLOWED, _REJECTED}:
            raise ValueError("status must be ALLOWED or REJECTED")
        if (self.reason_code is None) != (self.status == _ALLOWED):
            raise ValueError("REJECTED requires a reason code; ALLOWED must not have one")

    @property
    def allowed(self) -> bool:
        return self.status == _ALLOWED

    @property
    def rejected(self) -> bool:
        return self.status == _REJECTED


def _result(policy: ProtectionPolicy, reason: str | None = None) -> ProtectionEligibility:
    allowed = reason is None
    return ProtectionEligibility(
        status=_ALLOWED if allowed else _REJECTED,
        reason_code=reason,
        risk_notes=_RISK_NOTES,
        entry_allowed=allowed or not policy.required,
    )

The coordinator is deliberately independent of strategy scheduling and control
state.  Its only inputs are confirmed broker quantities/order updates, policy,
capabilities, a broker port, and a UTC clock.

_TERMINAL = frozenset({"CANCELED", "CANCELLED", "FILLED", "REJECTED", "EXPIRED"})

    """

class _WorkingExit:

    @property
    def working_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
        return self.quantity - self.cumulative_filled


@dataclass(slots=True)
class _CycleState:
    cycle_id: str
    confirmed_entry_quantity: Decimal = _ZERO
    confirmed_exit_quantity: Decimal = _ZERO
    avg_fill_price: Decimal | None = None
    status: str = "AWAITING_FILL"
    protective_order_id: str | None = None
    protective_order_quantity: Decimal = _ZERO
    protective_cumulative_filled: Decimal = _ZERO
    pending_replacement: bool = False
    pending_exit_quantity: Decimal = _ZERO
    pending_exit_reason: str | None = None
    working_exit: _WorkingExit | None = None
    updated_at: datetime | None = None
    last_error: str | None = None

    @property
    def remaining_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
        remaining = (
            self.confirmed_entry_quantity
            - self.confirmed_exit_quantity
            - self.protective_cumulative_filled
        )
        return max(_ZERO, remaining)

    @property
    def working_protective_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
        if self.protective_order_id is None:
            return _ZERO
        return self.protective_order_quantity - self.protective_cumulative_filled

    @property
    def working_exit_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
        return _ZERO if self.working_exit is None else self.working_exit.working_quantity


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _ProtectionSnapshot:
    cycle_id: str
    status: str
    confirmed_remaining_quantity: Decimal
    protective_order_id: str | None
    protective_working_quantity: Decimal
    exit_order_id: str | None
    exit_working_quantity: Decimal
    pending_replacement: bool
    pending_exit_quantity: Decimal
    updated_at: datetime | None
    last_error: str | None

    @property
    def working_sell_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
        return self.protective_working_quantity + self.exit_working_quantity


def _decimal(value: object, name: str, *, positive: bool = False) -> Decimal:
    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be Decimal")
    if not value.is_finite() or value < _ZERO or (positive and value == _ZERO):
        relation = "> 0" if positive else ">= 0"
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a finite Decimal {relation}")
    return value


def _utc(value: object, name: str) -> datetime:
    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be timezone-aware UTC")
    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must use UTC (zero offset)")
    return value.astimezone(UTC)


def _text(value: object, name: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-empty string")
    return value.strip()


def _status(value: object) -> str:
    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.strip():
        raise ValueError("status must be a non-empty string or status enum")
    return raw.strip().upper()


def _order_id(value: object) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return _text(value, "broker order id")
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for name in ("broker_order_id", "order_id", "id"):
            if name in value:
                return _text(value[name], "broker order id")
    for name in ("broker_order_id", "order_id", "id"):
        candidate = getattr(value, name, None)
        if candidate is not None:
            return _text(candidate, "broker order id")
    raise ValueError("broker acknowledgement did not contain an order id")


async def _await_if_needed(value: object) -> object:
    return await value if inspect.isawaitable(value) else value


class ProtectionCoordinator:
    """Serialize protection and exit orders for each PositionCycle id."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        broker: _ProtectionBrokerPort,
        clock: ClockPort,
        policy: ProtectionPolicy,
    ) -> None:
        if broker is None:
            raise TypeError("broker is required")
        if not callable(getattr(clock, "now", None)):
            raise TypeError("clock must provide now()")
        if not isinstance(policy, ProtectionPolicy):
            raise TypeError("policy must be ProtectionPolicy")
        self._broker = broker
        self._clock = clock
        self._policy = policy
        self._cycles: dict[str, _CycleState] = {}
        self._unprotected_cycles: set[str] = set()

    @property
    def entry_block_reasons(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        """Fresh-entry blocks raised by any currently unprotected filled cycle."""

        if not self._unprotected_cycles:
            return ()
        return ("UNPROTECTED_POSITION",)

    def check_entry_eligibility(
        self,
        policy: ProtectionPolicy,
        capabilities: BrokerProtectionCapabilities,
        mode: ExecutionMode | object,
        intended_qty: Decimal,
    ) -> ProtectionEligibility:
        """Evaluate protection before entry submission.

        ``entry_allowed`` on the result is false precisely when required
        protection is ineligible.  No strategy pause or holding-period input is
        accepted by this safety boundary.
        """

        return evaluate_policy(policy, capabilities, mode, intended_qty)

    async def on_confirmed_fill(
        self,
        cycle_id: str,
        cumulative_filled_qty: Decimal,
        avg_fill_price: Decimal,
        *,
        confirmed: bool = True,
    ) -> _ProtectionSnapshot | None:
        """Cover a positive, broker-confirmed cumulative entry fill."""

        cycle = _text(cycle_id, "cycle_id")
        quantity = _decimal(cumulative_filled_qty, "cumulative_filled_qty")
        price = _decimal(avg_fill_price, "avg_fill_price", positive=True)
        if not isinstance(confirmed, bool):
            raise TypeError("confirmed must be bool")
        if not confirmed or quantity == _ZERO:
            return self.current_protection(cycle)

        state = self._cycles.setdefault(cycle, _CycleState(cycle_id=cycle))
        if quantity < state.confirmed_entry_quantity:
            raise ValueError("cumulative_filled_qty must not decrease")
        state.confirmed_entry_quantity = quantity
        state.avg_fill_price = price
        state.updated_at = self._now()

        if state.working_exit is not None or state.pending_exit_quantity > _ZERO:
            return self._snapshot(state)
        if state.protective_order_id is None:
            await self._place_protection(state)
        elif state.working_protective_quantity != state.remaining_quantity:
            await self._request_replacement(state)
        return self._snapshot(state)

    async def on_exit_requested(
        self, cycle_id: str, qty: Decimal, reason: str
    ) -> _ProtectionSnapshot:
        """Queue or submit an exit without overlapping an effective stop."""

        state = self._require_cycle(cycle_id)
        quantity = _decimal(qty, "qty", positive=True)
        exit_reason = _text(reason, "reason")
        if state.remaining_quantity == _ZERO:
            raise ValueError("cannot exit a cycle with no confirmed remaining position")
        if state.working_exit is not None:
            raise RuntimeError("an exit order is already working for this cycle")
        requested = state.pending_exit_quantity + quantity
        if requested > state.remaining_quantity:
            raise ValueError("requested exit quantity exceeds confirmed remaining quantity")

        state.pending_exit_quantity = requested
        state.pending_exit_reason = exit_reason
        state.updated_at = self._now()
        if state.protective_order_id is not None:
            if not state.status.startswith("CANCEL_PENDING"):
                state.status = "CANCEL_PENDING_FOR_EXIT"
                await self._cancel_effective_protection(state)
            else:
